answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit pearl bond in the sable ledger. It decays 6 per epoch to a nadir floor of 10, then lapses unless renewed. Renewal is 30 for the first bond, 30+6(k-1) for the k-th under one key. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. A rented-pearl ring fails: each rented bond decays alone, and auditors replay the sable ledger, burning mismatched renewal keys. An honest agent pays 30.
